feeds.title: The Harry Binswanger Letter Blog
feeds.description: The Harry Binswanger Letter (HBL) is a membership site and email list service for those interested in Ayn Rand's philosophy, objectivism, and its application to today's culture. Harry Binswanger, a philosopher who was an associate and friend of Ayn Rand, is the author of How We Know: Epistemology on an Objectivist Foundation and is the creator and editor of The Ayn Rand Lexicon.

feeds.title: Ayn Rand Contra Human Nature
feeds.description: This wonderful blog chronicles exactly why and to what extent Ayn Rand was horribly incorrect on a number of issues. This is for the fence-sitting and fanatic but otherwise intelligent Objectivist alike. If the latter even exists.

feeds.title: Thinking Directions Blog
feeds.description: Jean Moroney, President of Thinking Directions, teaches managers and other professionals how to use targeted thinking to solve problems faster, make better decisions, and get projects finished. They use her tactics to be smarter about achieving their goals.

feeds.title: The Objective Standard
feeds.description: The Objective Standard (TOS) is the preeminent source for commentary from an Objectivist perspective, Objectivism being Ayn Rand's philosophy of reason, egoism, and capitalism. It offers in-depth articles on philosophy, politics, education, history, self-improvement, and the arts; reviews of books, movies, and television shows; and interviews with intellectuals, activists, and politicians.

feeds.title: Gus Van Horn
feeds.description: I am a part-time consultant, part-time stay-at-home-dad, and freelance cultural and political commentator who resides in the Baltimore area. Since my political views are based on my more fundamental philosophical views, I would describe myself more completely as an advocate of Objectivism, the philosophy of Ayn Rand. By that, I mean that as far as I understand Ayn Rand's philosophy, I fully agree with it.

feeds.title: An Objectivist Individualist
feeds.description: A blog on individualism, the rights of the individual, limited government, science, economics, energy, climate, education, business, and Ayn Rand. Our goal is to find and connect with students of Objectivism.

feeds.title: Objective Standard Institute Blog
feeds.description: Objective Standard Institute's mission is to teach the rising generation about the importance of philosophy, the principles of Objectivism, and related ideas for living fully and advancing liberty.

feeds.title: Objectivist
feeds.description: Objective reporting for the educated American.

feeds.title: Don't Let It Go
feeds.description: Amy Peikoff earned her BS in math/applied science and her JD at UCLA, where she served as an editor on the UCLA Law Review. Her goal in her writing and activism is to find issues and problems where her Objectivist perspective allows her to make a unique and valuable contribution.

feeds.title: The Objectivist Blog
feeds.description: We are radicals for capitalism, reason, and individual freedom, and we seek to combat the growing culture of collectivism, nihilism, and statism that pervades our modern culture (especially with today's youth). By writing this blog and participating in online discussions and livestreams, we hope to create an accessible forum for intellectual discussion. We hope to help young people to engage with Objectivism as applied to current events, history and life.

feeds.title: Objectivist v. Constructivist v. Theist
feeds.description: Opinion pieces from the column 'Taking Sides' by the Objectivist, the Constructivist, and the Theist, originally published in the Dunkirk-Fredonia Observer and the Jamestown Post-Journal.

feeds.title: Carl Barney » Objectivism
feeds.description: This section of my blog is for Objectivists and those interested in Ayn Rand's philosophy of Objectivism. Love of the good for being good is an idea that I draw from Ayn Rand's philosophy, Objectivism, and that permeates my life.

feeds.title: Ari Armstrong
feeds.description: Ari Armstrong is a columnist for Complete Colorado; the publisher of Contours of Liberty, IndySchooler, and Liberty 'Gator; the host of the Self in Society Podcast; and the author of What's Wrong with Ayn Rand's Objectivist Ethics, Reclaiming Liberalism, and Values of Harry Potter.
